input.raw_answer_text: Worked at Siemens as a backend engineer 2011-2015, then moved to a startup as a team lead 2015-2020.

expected_evidence.normalized_text: Worked at Siemens as a backend engineer, 2011-2015
Worked as a team lead at a startup, 2015-2020

acceptable_outputs: extracts each role/employer/period as its own neutral factual observation
keeps company names and dates exactly as stated, without embellishment
unacceptable_outputs: turns 'team lead' directly into a personality/leadership claim (e.g. 'natural born leader') at the evidence stage -- that inference belongs to claim synthesis, not evidence extraction
invents a job title, employer, or date range not present in the text
merges the two distinct roles into one vague observation, losing the employer/date detail
reviewer_notes: Tests Stage 2 brief section 15's explicit-fact-vs-inferred-claim distinction: CV facts about employment must land as direct evidence, never pre-baked into a personality conclusion at extraction time.

provenance.notes: Invented for Stage 2 golden-dataset coverage; no real candidate involved.
